feed.title: NPR Topics: Politics
feed.subtitle: Follow NPR Politics for nonpartisan coverage of government, elections, policy debates and voting rights. Plus weekday audio from The NPR Politics Podcast.

entry.title: Democrat Scott Colom wins the closest Senate race in the country
entry.summary: Mississippi hadn't elected a Democrat to the U.S. Senate in more than 40 years.

entry.title: Democrat Scott Colom wins Mississippi Senate race
entry.summary: Democrat Scott Colom has won election to the U.S. Senate in Mississippi, according to a race call by the Associated Press, defeating Republican Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith.

entry.title: Who is Jim Jordan, the House Republicans' pick for minority leader?
entry.summary: As House Republicans prepare for life in the minority, they're turning to Jim Jordan as their next leader. In Jordan, they've picked a conservative firebrand and one of Trump's most vocal defenders.

entry.title: These voters are looking for change, but don't have high hopes for a divided Congress
entry.summary: North Carolina swing voters are seeking change, but have low expectations that things will actually change.

entry.title: Kennedy relatives join the fight against Trump's arch, alleging harm to JFK's grave
entry.summary: Nine members of the Kennedy family have joined the legal fight against Trump's D.C. arch, arguing it would disrupt views and cast shadows over their ancestors' graves at Arlington National Cemetery.

entry.title: What's behind democratic socialists' historic victories in the midterms?
entry.summary: Historian and The New Yorker writer Jill Lepore says the DSA, once maligned, is no longer "beyond the political pale." She discusses the history of socialism in America, and its current resurgence.

entry.title: Following big Democratic wins, these swing voters are looking for results
entry.summary: For the swing voters NPR is regularly checking in with as part of its Swing Shift series, the election results brought mixed emotions, as does the pending Democratic control of Congress.

entry.title: House effectively ends Hegseth impeachment. And, 3 men accused of plotting U.K. attacks
entry.summary: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has been spared from the House's impeachment effort, at least for now. And, federal prosecutors arrested three men accused of being Iran-backed operatives.

entry.title: Kennedys sue to block Trump's arch
entry.summary: Descendants of President John F. Kennedy are asking a judge to block President Trump's monumental arch near Arlington National Cemetery.

entry.title: Ex-CIA officer on UK investigations into alleged Iran, Russia threats
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with former CIA senior executive clandestine service officer Daniel Hoffman about investigations in Britain into alleged threats linked to Iran and Russia.
